what: Plan adds design-pause-save --repo validation but leaves canonical pause-check call sites without --repo
scenario_or_breakage: A /design run bound to a non-default repo can hit .pause-requested; the prelude execs design-pause-save with only --issue, so the helper resolves the hub default before gh issue view, publish, and marker writes. The new validation only checks that default/resolved repo and does not cover this direct invocation surface.
suggested_fix: Update the canonical prelude and duplicated SKILL.md pause-check blocks to pass ${REPO:+--repo "$REPO"}, or route them through one tested snippet; add a structural test that pause-check invocations forward REPO.

what: SECURITY.md update is scoped only to design-log-publish, but the plan also changes the pause/resume marker write boundary
scenario_or_breakage: After the proposed pause-save guard lands, SECURITY.md would document design-log malformed --repo fail-closed behavior but not the pause-save direct GitHub issue read/write boundary that now rejects malformed non-empty --repo before gh/stateful marker work.
suggested_fix: Add one sentence to the existing /design pause/resume marker binding paragraph documenting the design-pause-save --repo OWNER/REPO validation and early invalid-repo failure before gh issue view, publish, or marker writes.
